evidence_frontier.summary: Exp021 evaluated a 4,278‑parameter w8 compression candidate on ECG200 and observed 887 aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions, exactly 10 fewer than the Alpha5 w16 control (897). The w12 candidate performed worse. The next step is a confirmation of the w8 boundary using integer‑count gating.

analysis.observation: Exp021 showed that reducing the local representation width from 16 to 8 lowered aggregate correct predictions by exactly ten on a single seed set. The result was reproducible under the same training protocol and dataset (ECG200).
analysis.hypothesis: When evaluated on an independent preregistered seed set, the w8 compression will not lose more than ten aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions relative to the Alpha5 w16 control, confirming the w8 boundary as a reproducible trade‑off.

hypothesis: The w8 local‑width candidate will retain performance within the pre‑registered relative gate (candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10) on a fresh seed set, demonstrating that the w8 boundary is reproducible.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Is the w8 compression boundary reproducible under integer‑count gating when evaluated on a fresh preregistered seed set?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 identified a precise 10‑prediction drop for w8 versus the w16 control. A confirmation experiment using a new seed set will test whether this boundary holds, satisfying the next preregistered question and avoiding any reinterpretation of Exp021 results.

procedure: Load the ECG200 dataset with the standard train (100) / test (100) split as used in Exp020/021.
Set the random seed list to [121,131,141,151,161] (preregistered).
For each seed, train the Alpha5 architecture with local_width = 8 for 50 epochs using the corrected training protocol.
For each seed, also train the Alpha5 w16 control (local_width = 16) for 50 epochs under identical conditions.
After training, evaluate Q.ANT aggregate correct predictions on the 100‑sample test set for each seed.
Sum correct predictions across the five seeds (max 5 × 100 = 500).
Apply the relative gate: candidate_total_correct ≥ control_total_correct − 10.

success_criteria.gate: candidate_total_correct >= control_total_correct - 10 on the combined 5*100 test predictions

proposal.risks: Simulation variance across seeds may obscure a small performance gap; limited test sample size (500 predictions) yields coarse granularity; any deviation from the exact seed list invalidates preregistration.
